home.home_2: WELCOME TO CÔTÉ GARE DENTAL PRACTICE
home.home_3: Your smile in the heart of Bussigny
home.home_4: Bussigny Dental Practice - Professional Dental Care
home.home_5: Many patients ask Dr. Popescu Ramona why she chose to open her dental practice in Bussigny. The answer is simple: it's a welcoming, evolving community on a human scale, where close relationships and trust take on their full meaning.
home.home_6: From her first visit to Bussigny, Dr. Popescu was charmed by the friendly atmosphere and dynamism of the region. Located just a stone's throw from the train station, her clinic is designed as an accessible, modern, and reassuring space—where each patient is welcomed with care and attention.
home.home_7: Creating lasting smiles in a trusting environment
home.home_8: Dr. Popescu strongly believes in a personalized approach to dentistry. She takes the time to explain each step of treatment, no matter how complex the case, so that patients feel confident and well-informed.
home.home_9: She welcomes both children and adults, with special attention paid to anxious patients or toddlers experiencing care for the first time. Her goal: to combine skill, gentleness, and precision to help you achieve a healthy, dazzling smile in the best possible conditions.
home.home_10: Contact us today and discover the excellent dental care you deserve!
home.home_23: Dr. Ramona Popescu, a qualified dentist since 2009, is passionate about cosmetic and reconstructive dentistry. She opened the clinic in October 2024, ready to welcome adults and children for personalized care, from simple check-ups to more complex treatments. Her approach: listening, trust and modern technology to help you keep smiling, quite simply.
home.home_26: Dr. Ismaili joined our team in March 2025. Holder of a doctorate in dental surgery and specialized for over ten years in oral implantology (DIU), he puts his expertise at the service of our patients. Always smiling and attentive, he takes the time to explain each step of the treatment in order to make your care clearer, more comfortable and pleasant.
home.home_29: Tatiana has been a qualified dental assistant since 2015. Passionate about her profession, she puts her expertise and kindness at the service of patients every day. Responsible and organized, she ensures the smooth running of treatments, the sterilization of equipment and the quality of reception at the practice. Her professionalism and attention to detail make her an essential pillar of the dental team.
home.home_32: We are pleased to welcome Stefania, our new apprentice, who joined our team in August 2025. Dynamic and motivated, she brings a fresh perspective and a real desire to learn. We are happy to support her in her journey and to share our expertise with her.

pricing.heading: Dentist in Bussigny – Experience and Quality in Dental Care
pricing.highlight: Looking for a dentist in Bussigny who offers quality services in a modern, friendly environment?
pricing.intro_p1: In our practice, located near the CFF station, you'll find exactly what you're looking for.
pricing.intro_p2: The Bussigny dentists on our team have over 15 years of experience and are dedicated to offering you the best solutions for your dental health. We take pride in making every visit deliver a personalized approach tailored to your specific needs and budget. Whether you need preventive consultations, cosmetic dentistry, or solutions for complex dental problems, our Bussigny dentists are here for you.
pricing.section2_title: Our clinic offers a family-friendly, relaxing atmosphere, ideal for feeling comfortable during your treatments.
pricing.section2_p1: Our Bussigny dentists use state-of-the-art technology and gentle, conservative treatment methods to ensure every patient receives the care they need. By choosing a dentist in Bussigny, you'll benefit from professionalism, safety, and top-quality dental care in a modern, accessible setting.
pricing.section2_p2: Our team of dentists is here to listen, understand your concerns, and offer fast, effective treatments that improve your dental health and restore confidence in your smile.
pricing.section2_p3: Contact us to schedule a consultation with a Bussigny dentist and discover how we can deliver the dental care you deserve.
